Title: Living Vanduul Sample
Description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System 
Hostile Forces: Shattered Blade
Equipment Specs: Combat Ready
Briefing: 

Intel has been received that Shattered Blade have possession of a cryopod believed to contain a living Vanduul sample. Reports say that this pod is marked out by having blue trim on its casing.

Any Intersec contractor that locates one of these cryopods should consider its acquisition a vital priority and adjust their mission parameters accordingly.

Once secured, the cryopod should be delivered with all due haste to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>.

Respectfully,   

Deacon Tobin 
Operations Manager 
InterSec Defense Solutions
